blocks.title: Pehli (1st) ionization energy
blocks.text: Gas halat mein kisi element ke ek mole atoms ke har atom se ek electron nikal kar gas wale 1+ ions ka ek mole banane ke liye jitni energy chahiye, use 1st ionization energy (ΔHᵢ₁) kehte hain.

blocks.text_alt: Na(g) → Na⁺(g) + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₁ = 494 kJ mol⁻¹
Ca(g) → Ca⁺(g) + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₁ = 590 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Agar gas wale 1+ ions ke ek mole mein har ion se doosra electron nikala jaye to use 2nd ionization energy, ΔHᵢ₂, kehte hain. Phir calcium ki misal:

blocks.text_alt: Ca⁺(g) → Ca²⁺(g) + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₂ = 1150 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Gas wale 2+ ions ke ek mole mein har ion se teesra electron nikalna 3rd ionization energy hai. Calcium ki misal:

blocks.text_alt: 3rd ionisation energy: Ca²⁺(g) → Ca³⁺(g) + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₃ = 4940 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Ek element ki kai ionization energies ho sakti hain; un ki tadaad us ke atomic number ke barabar hoti hai (jitne electrons, utni ionization energies).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Har agla electron nikalna mehnga hai: 590, phir 1150, phir 4940 kJ mol⁻¹. Ion jitna zyada positive ho, baqi electrons ko utni zyada mazbooti se pakarta hai. Calcium ka teesra electron andar ke poore (noble gas jaise) shell se nikalta hai, is liye qeemat achanak bohat barh jati hai.
Ionization energy par asar dalne wale factors
Kisi element ki ionization energy kitni hogi, yeh in factors par depend karta hai:
i) Nuclear charge

Effective nuclear charge jitna zyada, electrostatic kashish (attraction) utni zyada, aur atom se electron nikalna utna mushkil. Is liye effective nuclear charge barhne se ionization energy barhti hai.
ii) Atom ya ion ka size
Bare atoms mein nucleus aur bahar wale electrons ke darmiyan kashish kamzor hoti hai. Is liye atom ka size barhne se ionization energy kam hoti hai, aur size kam ho to ionization energy zyada.
iii) Electronic arrangement
Aadhe bhare (half-filled) aur poore bhare (completely-filled) orbitals zyada stable hote hain. Is liye agar electron poore ya aadhe bhare shell se nikalna ho to ionization energy zyada hoti hai.

items: Noble gases ki ionization energy apne apne period mein sab se zyada hai, kyun ke un ke shells poore bhare aur bohat stable hain (ns² np⁶).
Oxygen ki ionization energy nitrogen se kam hai. Dono ki electronic configuration yeh hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein nitrogen ki configuration 1s² 2s⁰ 2px¹ 2py¹ 2pz¹ chhapi hai; 2s⁰ ghalat hai, sahi 2s² hai (nitrogen ke 7 electrons). Oxygen ki configuration 1s² 2s² 2px¹ 2py¹ 2pz⁰ chhapi hai, jis mein sirf 6 electrons hain; sahi 1s² 2s² 2px² 2py¹ 2pz¹ hai (8 electrons). Kitab oxygen ki pehli ionization energy 1365 kJ mol⁻¹ likhti hai; asal qeemat taqreeban 1314 kJ mol⁻¹ hai, jo phir bhi nitrogen (1403) se kam hai.
Nitrogen ke nucleus mein oxygen se ek proton kam hai, phir bhi nitrogen ka 2p subshell aadha bhara (half-filled) hone ki wajah se extra stable hai, is liye N atom se electron nikalna mushkil hai.
iv) Shielding effect
Shielding (andar ke electrons ka parda) jitni zyada, valence electrons nikalna utna asaan. Andar ke electrons jitne zyada, screening effect utna zyada, aur ionization energy utni kam.
v) Spin-pair repulsion

Jab ek hi orbital mein do electrons ulte spin ke saath jore (spin-paired) mein hon, to un ki aapas ki repulsion ki wajah se un mein se ek ko nikalna, akele (unpaired) electron ke muqable mein, thora asaan hota hai, yani ionization energy thori kam hoti hai.

Oxygen ke ek 2p orbital mein do spin-paired electrons hain. In mein se ek ko nikalne ki ionization energy nisbatan kam hai, kyun ke jore wale electrons ek doosre ko dhakelte hain. Nitrogen ke teenon 2p electrons akele (unpaired) hain. In mein se ek nikalne mein zyada energy lagti hai, kyun ke wahan yeh repulsion nahi hai.
Ionization energy ke periodic trends

Group mein neeche jate hue nuclear charge barhta hai, lekin atom ka size aur shielding karne wale electrons bhi barhte hain, is liye ionization energy oopar se neeche kam hoti hai. Group 1 mein tarteeb yeh hai: Li > Na > K > Rb > Cs. Maslan Cs ka 6s valence electron nucleus se zyada door hai, is liye Rb ke 5s electron ke muqable asani se nikal jata hai.

Period mein baen se daen shells ki tadaad wohi rehti hai jab ke effective nuclear charge barhta hai, is liye electron nikalna mushkil hota jata hai. Electrons bhi barhte hain, magar ek hi shell ke electrons ki shielding barabar hoti hai, is liye use nahi gina jata. Nateeja: period mein ionization energy barhti hai.

blocks.alt: H se Ca tak pehli ionization energy (oopar) aur atomic number Z (baen se daen) ka line graph, har nuqte par unsur ka naam. He, Ne aur Ar par chotiyan; Li, Na aur K par gehraiyan. Be ke baad B, N ke baad O, Mg ke baad Al aur P ke baad S par chhoti girawat; aakhir mein K neeche aur Ca thora oopar.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.6: Periods mein ionization energies ki tabdeeli (kitab ki Figure 1.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph mein har period ka pattern ek jaisa hai: shuru mein alkali metal (Li, Na, K) sab se neeche, aakhir mein noble gas (He, Ne, Ar) sab se oopar. Beech mein chhote jhatke dekhein: B Be se neeche aur Al Mg se neeche, kyun ke naya electron p subshell mein jata hai; O N se neeche aur S P se neeche, kyun ke wahan pehla spin-paired 2p (ya 3p) electron hai.

Periods 1 se 3 ki ionization energies ka trend Figure 1.6 mein hai. Figure batati hai ke noble gases ki ionization energy sab se zyada hai, kyun ke un ka bahar wala shell poora hai aur electron nikalna bohat mushkil hai, jab ke alkali metals ki ionization energy sab se kam hai.
Quick Check 1.6

blocks.prompt: a) Wajah ke saath samjhayein: (i) Boron ki 1st ionization energy beryllium se kam hai. (ii) Aluminium ki 1st ionization energy magnesium se kam hai.
blocks.explanation: (i) Beryllium (1s² 2s²) ka 2s subshell poora aur stable hai. Boron (1s² 2s² 2p¹) ka akela 2p electron zyada energy wale, nucleus se thore door subshell mein hai aur 2s electrons use shield karte hain, is liye asani se nikal jata hai. (ii) Yehi baat ek period neeche: magnesium ka 3s² poora hai, aur aluminium ka akela 3p¹ electron asani se nikalta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Group mein neeche jate hue ionization energy ka kya trend hai? Wajah batayein. (Kitab “group 3” likhti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Group mein neeche ionization energy kam hoti hai. Har qadam par naya shell jurta hai, atom bara hota hai aur shielding barhti hai; bahar wala electron nucleus se door aur kamzor bandha hota hai, is liye barhte nuclear charge ke bawajood asani se nikal jata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: 1st ionization energy: gas halat ke atoms ke ek mole ke har atom se ek electron nikalne ki energy (Na 494, Ca 590 kJ mol⁻¹); 2nd aur 3rd is se zyada (Ca 1150, 4940).
Zyada nuclear charge aur poore ya aadhe bhare subshells se barhti; bara size, zyada shielding aur spin-pair repulsion se kam hoti hai.
Group mein neeche kam (Li > Na > K > Rb > Cs), period mein baen se daen zyada; noble gases sab se oopar.
